entries.title: Job 41:1
segments: ¶Wilt thou draw out the leviathan with the hook, and press down his tongue with a cord?

entries.title: Job 41:2
segments: Wilt thou put a rush-rope into his nose, and pierce his jaw with a spike?

entries.title: Job 41:3
segments: Will he make many supplications unto thee? or will he speak softly unto thee?

entries.title: Job 41:4
segments: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him as a bondman for ever?

entries.title: Job 41:5
segments: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird, and wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

entries.title: Job 41:6
segments: Shall partners make traffic of him, will they divide him among merchants?

entries.title: Job 41:7
segments: Wilt thou fill his skin with darts, and his head with fish-spears?

entries.title: Job 41:8
segments: Lay thy hand upon him; remember the battle, --do no more!

entries.title: Job 41:9
segments: Lo, hope as to him is belied: is not one cast down even at the sight of him?

entries.title: Job 41:10
segments: None is so bold as to stir him up; and who is he that will stand before me?

entries.title: Job 41:11
segments: ¶Who hath first given to me, that I should repay [him]? [Whatsoever is] under the whole heaven is mine.

entries.title: Job 41:12
segments: I will not be silent as to his parts, the story of his power, and the beauty of his structure.

entries.title: Job 41:13
segments: Who can uncover the surface of his garment? who can come within his double jaws?

entries.title: Job 41:14
segments: Who can open the doors of his face? Round about his teeth is terror.

entries.title: Job 41:15
segments: The rows of his shields are a pride, shut up together [as with] a close seal.

entries.title: Job 41:16
segments: One is so near to another that no air can come between them;

entries.title: Job 41:17
segments: They are joined each to its fellow; they stick together, and cannot be sundered.

entries.title: Job 41:18
segments: His sneezings flash light, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

entries.title: Job 41:19
segments: Out of his mouth go forth flames; sparks of fire leap out:

entries.title: Job 41:20
segments: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a boiling pot and cauldron.

entries.title: Job 41:21
segments: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.

entries.title: Job 41:22
segments: In his neck lodgeth strength, and terror danceth before him.

entries.title: Job 41:23
segments: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are fused upon him, they cannot be moved.

entries.title: Job 41:24
segments: His heart is firm as a stone, yea, firm as the nether [millstone].

entries.title: Job 41:25
segments: When he raiseth himself up, the mighty are afraid: they are beside themselves with consternation.

entries.title: Job 41:26
segments: If any reach him with a sword, it cannot hold; neither spear, nor dart, nor harpoon.

entries.title: Job 41:27
segments: He esteemeth iron as straw, bronze as rotten wood.

entries.title: Job 41:28
segments: The arrow will not make him flee; slingstones are turned with him into stubble.

entries.title: Job 41:29
segments: Clubs are counted as stubble; he laugheth at the shaking of a javelin.

entries.title: Job 41:30
segments: His under parts are sharp potsherds: he spreadeth a threshing-sledge upon the mire.

entries.title: Job 41:31
segments: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot; he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment;

entries.title: Job 41:32
segments: He maketh the path to shine after him: one would think the deep to be hoary.

entries.title: Job 41:33
segments: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.

entries.title: Job 41:34
segments: He beholdeth all high things; he is king over all the proud beasts.
